[[File:Droidbattery.png|thumb|right|250px|A droid battery.]]

A '''battery''' was a type of portable power supply. The electrical storage device was utilized inside [[music player]]s, [[Breath mask/Legends|gas masks]], [[Infrared goggles/Legends|infrared goggles]], and head-mounted [[Glowrod/Legends|lanterns]]. They also powered [[MSE-6 series repair droid/Legends|MSE-6-series repair droids]], though to what extent was unclear. They also had a tendency to run down relatively quickly.
